note: T12 API as rules, not a handwritten path list. Commands come from screens.json commit:* effects. Codes live in codes.json. Cadences are derived from the pack.

sampler_samples_per_tick.why: Samples per city hour. Period is derived and must divide tick_length_real_seconds and stay at or under one minute

ws_heartbeat_s.why: Three pulses inside one sampler period so a dead socket is seen before the next price

sampler_period_max_s.why: HUD promises stock prices on a minute cadence; a slower sampler cannot keep that row

domain_conflict_http.why: A player-action refusal is a conflict with the current city. The client branches on code, not on a second HTTP per refusal

command.why: One commit effect, one path. Required fields make a lost withdraw replay-safe

state.why: One snapshot. A path that names a screen_id would make the server own the HUD

pack.why: Immutable pack by hash. An old shift finds its pack from the tick header, not latest

ready.why: Readiness is pack_hash plus migration_version. A listening socket without a pin would price a foreign pack

ws.why: One socket per city. Heartbeat cadence is ws_heartbeat_s so three pulses fit inside one sampler period

auth_nonce.why: One-shot nonce for a claimed address. Auth is not a commit effect so L232 bijection stays closed

auth_session.why: Wallet session needs address nonce signature; demo session has no address. Required fields stay empty so both kinds share one pack route

derived.price_channel_period_s: equals sampler_period_s; the price channel fires on a new sample
derived.session_ttl_s: ticks_per_city_day times tick_length_real_seconds; one city day in real seconds
derived.nonce_ttl_s: tick_length_real_seconds; one city hour, the same window as a voucher
derived.voucher_ttl_s: tick_length_real_seconds; one city hour, the window the daily limit still covers
derived.ws_heartbeat_ms: ws_heartbeat_s times milliseconds in one second
derived.sampler_period_ms: sampler_period_s times milliseconds in one second
derived.tick_length_real_ms: tick_length_real_seconds times milliseconds in one second
